symptom: `alter settings runtime ( JavaVersion: '17' )` on a Mendix 9.24 model printed "Unchanged model settings" — a silent no-op instead of an error that the property does not exist on that version
cause: `refuseIfNotStored` exempted JavaVersion unconditionally because it is stored under one of two keys (JavaVersion / JavaMajorVersion), but a 9.x document carries neither, and `settingsoverlay.SetJavaVersion` writes nothing when `JavaVersionKey(raw)==""`
insight: An exemption from a presence gate written for 'stored under an alias' must still check that some alias is present: the alias resolver returning "" is the not-stored case. DESCRIBE already gated on `JavaVersionKey != ""`; the ALTER path had not been made symmetric. Revert proof: MockBackend with a 9.24-shaped part (no Java key) returns nil from alterSettings
